jobs.employer_name: Heraeus Consulting & IT Solutions GmbH, HRdirekt
jobs.description:
The following challenges await you:

- As Enterprise Architect (m/f/d) AI Governance & Architecture, you will shape, position and further develop the Enterprise Architecture discipline with a dedicated focus on Artificial Intelligence within the Heraeus Group.
- You will define and evolve enterprise-wide AI reference architectures, architecture principles, guardrails and decision frameworks to ensure that AI initiatives are scalable, secure, compliant and aligned with the overall business and IT strategy.
- In close collaboration within IT,  the AI & Digitalization Office and key stakeholders such as Information Security, Legal, Compliance, Data Protection and Risk Management, you will help establish a consistent and pragmatic approach to AI governance across the group.
- You will contribute to the further development of the AI governance process, ensuring that current and future regulatory requirements, internal policies and enterprise architecture standards are appropriately reflected in architectural decision-making.
- Furthermore, you will support the evaluation, classification and prioritization of AI-related initiatives and use cases from an enterprise architecture perspective, considering business value, architectural fit, risk, compliance, reusability and long-term portfolio impact.
- You will help build transparency across the AI application and technology portfolio, identify synergies, avoid unnecessary complexity and promote reusable capabilities, platforms and patterns across the organization.
- You will consult and advise IT, business and AI teams on architectural best practices for AI-enabled solutions, ensuring alignment with defined enterprise architecture standards, target architectures and governance guidelines.
- Last but not least, you will establish and maintain strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, business partners, architects and governance bodies to ensure close alignment between business ambitions, AI opportunities and enterprise-wide architectural integrity.

Your profile:

- Several years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, IT architecture, business architecture or technology strategy; experience in governance-related roles is beneficial.
- Good understanding of enterprise architecture methods, architecture governance, IT landscapes, cloud technologies, application architectures and digital transformation topics.
- Solid understanding of AI trends, AI-enabled business capabilities and the implications of AI for enterprise architecture, governance, risk and compliance - without the need to act as a deep technical AI/ML specialist.
- Experience in defining architecture principles, reference architectures, guardrails, standards or governance processes in complex organizational environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory, security, data protection and compliance considerations related to AI, digital technologies or data-driven solutions is an advantage.
- Ability to translate business needs, regulatory requirements and technology trends into pragmatic architectural guidance and decision criteria.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural and governance topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders in German and English.

What we offer:

- Strong salary package - attractive base salary plus bonus and support for private pension plan
- Modern working time arrangements - time sovereignty without time recording, focus on results-oriented work
- Regular time off - 30 days annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company closures on bridge days and between years), special leave for special occasions, life phase account for paid time off (e.g. sabbatical, earlier retirement)
- Additional benefits - subsidized public transport, discounts in many (online) stores, company medical service with comprehensive preventive medical check-ups, sports facilities and employee canteen with freshly prepared meals every day
- Sustainability and social commitment - sustainability as part of the corporate strategy and targeted support for initiatives in the areas of education, family and science through our own foundations

jobs.description:
As Enterprise Architect – Strategic Domains (m/f/d), you will help shape the future Enterprise Architecture practice within the Heraeus Group, with a particular focus on strategically important business and IT domains.

You will work at the interface of business strategy, IT roadmap and transformation portfolio, creating transparency, direction and architectural guidance for complex cross-domain topics.

Your key responsibilities will include:

- Shaping and evolving enterprise architecture practices across strategically relevant domains, ensuring alignment with business priorities, IT strategy and long-term transformation goals.
- Developing capability- and location-spanning reference architectures and strategic target architectures that provide clear orientation for future business and IT decisions.
- Supporting portfolio and investment decisions with architectural impact assessments, transparency and pragmatic recommendations.
- Coaching business and IT stakeholders in top-down architecture planning and helping translate strategic objectives into clear architectural priorities and roadmaps.
- Contributing to the further development of architecture governance, principles, standards and guardrails to enable consistent and value-driven architecture decisions across central and local domains.
- Moderating architecture discussions and helping stakeholders find viable solutions that balance business needs, technological options and economic considerations.
- Building strong partnerships with business functions, IT teams, domain experts and architects across the organization.
- Advising business and IT teams on architectural best practices while ensuring alignment with defined Enterprise Architecture standards and guidelines.

What you can look forward to:

- role with real impact: you will help shape strategic domains and contribute to the future direction of Enterprise Architecture within an international group.
- A broad variety of exciting topics across business and IT, with the opportunity to work across organizational boundaries.
- The chance to create transparency, simplify complexity and enable better decisions in a dynamic transformation environment.
- A collaborative team culture where ownership, curiosity and pragmatic thinking are highly valued.
- The opportunity to act as a trusted advisor and enabler for business and IT stakeholders.

Your profile:

- Several years of experience in enterprise architecture, business architecture, domain architecture, IT strategy or a comparable role in a complex, preferably international organization.
- Understanding of enterprise architecture methods, target architecture development, architecture governance, principles and standards.
- Ability to translate business strategies and domain-specific requirements into clear, pragmatic architectural guidance without getting lost in unnecessary technical detail.
- Good understanding of current technological trends, innovations and state-of-the-art solutions, as well as their relevance for business transformation.
- Experience in facilitating architecture decisions and aligning different stakeholder perspectives across business, IT and architecture.
- A hands-on architecture driven mindset and the motivation to actively support architecture concepts from early idea to practical implementation together with business and IT teams.
- Strong communication, moderation and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural topics clearly and convincingly to different audiences.
- Fluent German and English skills.
- Certifications such as TOGAF or equivalent qualifications are an advantage.
- You enjoy working independently, taking ownership and contributing as a motivated team player who wants to make a visible difference.

What we offer:

- Strong salary package - attractive base salary plus bonus and support for private pension plan
- Modern working time arrangements - time sovereignty without time recording, focus on results-oriented work
- Regular time off - 30 days annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company closures on bridge days and between years), special leave for specialoccasions, life phase account for paid time off (e.g. sabbatical, earlier retirement)
- Additional benefits - subsidized public transport, discounts in many (online) stores, company medical service with comprehensive preventive medical check-ups, sports facilities and employee canteen with freshly prepared meals every da
- Sustainability and social commitment - sustainability as part of the corporate strategy and targeted support for initiatives in the areas of education, family and science through our own foundations

Sounds like you?

Then we look forward to meeting you. Join us and help shape architecture that creates transparency, enables better decisions and supports the future development of the Heraeus Group.

- Flexibility, team spirit, ability to work under pressure, willingness to always learn

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

As a Data Analytics, Data Science & AI Manager, you will lead the strategic transformation of complex operational data into cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics solutions. Operating at the intersection of supply chain execution, predictive engineering, and machine learning, you will drive the design and deployment of end-to-end data products, automated workflows, and enterprise AI models across the Procurement Operations Cabin Supply Chain and Quality environment. Bridging the gap between modern IT infrastructure and core business operations, you will serve as a key technical leader—fostering an AI-first, data-driven culture to optimize end-to-end performance and business excellence.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautical legacy.

Your benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA

Your tasks and responsibilities

- AI Strategy, Data Science & Predictive Analytics: Architect intelligent automation workflows and decision-support systems that embed AI directly into daily operational and procurement processes
- Data Architecture, Pipeline & Data Engineering Leadership: Ensure robust data governance, pipeline efficiency, and data quality standards across all analytics products
- Analytics Delivery, Stakeholder Management & Visualization: Serve as the primary technical interface and thought partner between operational business units, executive stakeholders, and the broader IT/Data engineering ecosystem
- Process Engineering & Operational Impact: Identify high-impact opportunities where advanced analytics, natural language processing, and computer vision/ML can drive process efficiency, cost reduction, and quality improvement

Your boarding pass

- Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field
- Deep expertise in Data Engineering / Data modeling and business intelligence tools (e.g., Skywise, Power BI, Tableau)
- Domain & Process Expertise: Proven track record leading data science initiatives within aerospace, automotive, supply chain, or complex manufacturing industries. Solid foundation in continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile/Scrum)
- Outstanding ability to articulate complex technical architectures, model outcomes, and AI capabilities to non-technical executive leadership and cross-functional teams
- ​Advanced proficiency in Python and production-grade SQL (skills in R or additional languages are a plus)
- Ideally, proven hands-on experience deploying Machine Learning algorithms, predictive analytics, or enterprise AI/LLM solutions in operational environments
- Languages: Fluency in English is required; German skills are beneficial

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Disabled applicants will be given preference in case of equal qualification.

Ready for take-off?

Apply now with your resume, salary expectations and notice period to take your career to the next level!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

The Leibniz Institute of Virology (LIV) is an independent research institution for basic biomedical research. As a foundation under civil law and member of the Leibniz Association, the institute occupies a leading position both nationally and internationally.

The Research Department Viral Zoonoses - One Health, headed by Prof. Dr. Gülşah Gabriel, investigates the interspecies transmission of influenza A viruses from animals to humans and the molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis in humans, particularly with regard to risk factors (pregnancy, obesity, and gender dependence). The department aims to identify and characterize viral and cellular determinants driving increased pathogenicity and transmissibility. These insights are further extended to other respiratory viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 and RSV, with particular attention to post-acute sequelae and their long-term impact. Ultimately, the knowledge gained will inform the development of novel antiviral strategies.

We are looking for a highly motivated, ambitious, and team-oriented candidate for a

Postdoc Position (f/m/x)
Conduct and shape a research project on the pathogenesis of respiratory virus infections under BSL-2 and BSL-3 conditions
Work as an independent researcher with accountability towards the research project
Preparation and submission of animal experimentation applications in compliance with regulatory requirements, including direct liaison with the relevant authorities to ensure timely approval
Integrate into the research team and provide support for junior members / students
Present research findings at national and international level
Develop future research projects and draft manuscripts

Solid expertise in virology or cell biology and experimental laboratory work
Experience in conducting animal experiments
Strong commitment, team spirit, very good communication and organizational skills, and ability to work in an independent and flexible manner
PhD degree in life sciences
Very good German and English language skills (oral and written)

Working as part of a highly motivated team in a state-of-the-art, international research environment with excellent core facilities
Remuneration according to EG 13 TV-AVH (Hamburg Employment Law Association Collective Agreement) (comparable to TVöD - Civil Service Collective Agreement), including company pension scheme
30 days of annual vacation
Opportunity to obtain FELASA C certification, providing the qualification to independently conduct animal experimentation
Further training opportunities, including subsidized English and German courses at the institute
Grant for unscheduled child care
Health protection offers at the institute (in cooperation with voiio GmbH)
Flexible, family-friendly working hours
HVV Deutschlandticket subsidy
Canteen use subsidy

The position is initially limited for two years with starting date January 1, 2027.
